rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Shodan is a community MCP server wrapping the Shodan cybersecurity search engine API. It provides tools for host information lookup, database searching, alert management, network scanning, and exploit archive queries, enabling AI assistants to interact with Shodan's extensive internet-connected device data.
